metadata.title: Brief von Stefan Zweig an Hannah Altmann [Juli 1940], SZ-AAL/B1.39

context:
## Dieses Dokument

- Titel: Brief von Stefan Zweig an Hannah Altmann [Juli 1940], SZ-AAL/B1.39
- Signatur: SZ-AAL/B1.39
- Datum: 07.1940
- Objekttyp: Brief
- Umfang: 3 Scans

pages.transcription:
Dear Hannah, we had to postpone the depar
ture as the answers from South America
are not yet arrived and so we have to stay
here - it is not too hot and we have more
people to see as we want to. Altogether
we are not at all to complain and
I use the time for preparing the lectures
and other work. Here is a great action
for the refugees in France and we hope
to get some of them over - on the other
hand there are contradicting news about
the transfer of British children and
I do not know if you will and can
send Eva over, but you may be sure
that our friends will take best care
of her. I know it is a difficult task
to decide about and I would not venture
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief in violetter Tinte. Die Lesbarkeit ist gut.

pages.transcription:
to influence your decision - what can be
done on our part is done and will be done
through our friends. For Eva[?] I have
done my best and would not wonder if
it would be successful - like in England
we are occupied more with other people's
worries than our own. We dream sometimes
of our garden and of a peaceful world
- let us hope we will soon sit together
in our conservatory and speak from this
time on with relief. Kindest regards for
you all. Yours ever

Stefan Zweig
It seems that letters are now quicker by
boat than through the Clipper - the best
way is to tear the same letter in duplicate
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief in violetter Tinte. Fortsetzung von Seite 1.
Farbskala/Grauskala fuer Archivierung. Der Textausschnitt in der Mitte ist eine Wiederholung des Textes von Seite 2.

result.confidence_notes: Der Text ist sehr gut lesbar, die Handschrift ist klar. Ein Wort in Zeile 3 auf Seite 2 ('Eva' oder 'Erdmann'?) ist leicht unsicher, ich habe es als 'Eva' transkribiert, da es im Kontext des Briefes (Erwähnung von Eva auf Seite 1) Sinn ergibt.
